shape_push_v1.responsibility: Choose boundary contact, inward direction and short distance; not robot path, semantics or success.
shape_push_v1.selection_cues: Current selected rigid planar track differs from explicit geometric objective and safely accessible boundary exists.
shape_push_v1.entry_conditions: Fresh associated Scene, commissioned horizontal table/camera/tool calibration, explicit instance/goal/reference, tool envelope and workspace; ambiguity resolved upstream.
shape_push_v1.continuation_conditions: Fresh post-stroke object/neighbor geometry, same instance/reference/goal/calibration; observed response and executor feedback; at most one stroke before reobserve.
shape_push_v1.exit_conditions: Proposal, independently measured stable at-goal, stale/missing/ambiguous geometry, no candidate, calibration required, interrupted or executor replan after two nonprogress events.
shape_push_v1.successor_readiness: Planner receives boundary-derived standoff/contact/end flange objectives, explicit selected-object contact allowance, full collision model and commissioned guards. Must revalidate after arrival; prepare completion never task success.
shape_push_v1.switch_procedure: Cancel outstanding ticket, stop, reobserve, reassign actor/goal or view/staging; never resume source-index or stale continuation.
shape_push_v1.failure_signatures: Merge/split/occlusion, stale scene, calibration error, no progress, unexpected neighbor motion, loss of contact, table/obstacle conflict, invalid insertion, guard stop, planner rejection.
shape_push_v1.memory_reset_rules: Reset on instance/reference/goal/calibration changes or interruption; stateless learned model, external causal progress counter only.
shape_push_v1.observation_dependencies: 96-point full boundary with holes/normals; causal SAM or validated associated Scene; explicit goal delta, protected contours, workspace, metric uncertainty and tool radius/contact height. Raw RGB conversion also accepts K/dist/T_base_cam/top height; no future data online.
shape_push_v1.training_evidence: Original 12 cuts and both complete authorized recordings retained. Dense local state examples plus sparse original anchors, inferred multiview metric/contact labels, masked primitive channels; final all-valid-data fit from both episodes. Exact counts/audits in preparation reports.
shape_push_v1.limitations: No independent novel-shape/word evaluation, no semantic ground truth, pseudo-label uncertainty, only same-inventory two episodes, no physical robot or commissioned executor/guard integration. Generic SAM proposals require verified association; Agent semantic/layout competence is upstream and not measured here.
